As one of Australasia's leading technology providers, we work with customers across industries to solve real-world problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. Whether we're supporting governments, enterprise organizations, or growing businesses, we're committed to creating meaningful outcomes for our customers, communities, and each other. About The Role Our Service Desk Agents are the first point of contact for our clients. No two days will be the same as you'll be proactively problem solving any customer issues that come your way or escalating them as appropriate. As part of the Managed Services team, you'll provide high quality, efficient support to our clients and their customers through responding to telephone calls, emails and alert monitoring. Following ITIL processes, you'll identify, troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests. We're looking for: Someone who wants to be part of a team that is striving to achieve the best possible outcome for all our customers, and develop skills and knowledge that form the foundation of a career in IT. We're currently hiring for our upcoming intake commencing 12th January 2027 , so you'll need to be available to start on this date. In our successful candidates we are looking for: Self-starters who are motivated to kick-start their careers in technology Team players who have excellent interpersonal skills (you'll be working with people just as much as computers) Customer-centric superstars — we pride ourselves on delivering our best work to our customers Awesome problem-solvers who have fresh ideas and are willing to give anything a go. Hours The operational hours for the Service Desk are Monday to Sunday 6am to 10pm, to be successful for a Full-Time role you will need to have full availability to work across these hours on a rotating roster. Culture And Benefits Join a team where you'll be supported to grow your career, prioritize your wellbeing, and make a genuine impact. From industry-leading learning and development opportunities to parental leave, wellbeing support, and employee benefits, we're committed to helping our people thrive both professionally and personally We're passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and inspired to do their best work. Whether you're developing new skills, tackling complex challenges, or collaborating with some of the best minds in the industry, you'll be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and making a genuine difference. Why you will love working here Paid parental leave 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (DataCare) Ongoing learning, certifications, and career development opportunities Access to industry-leading learning platforms and future skills training Recognition programmes that celebrate great work Great employee discounts and financial wellbeing benefits Meaningful work that makes a real impact

review_candidates.title: Senior Graphic Designer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Alpha Pack, established in May 2013 in the 6 October Industrial Zone in Cairo, Egypt, specializes in manufacturing all types of corrugated carton. The company provides tailored carton solutions that support diverse packaging needs for a wide range of products. Alpha Pack focuses on consistent quality, competitive pricing, and creative packaging ideas to help customers strengthen their product presentation. The organization emphasizes reliable, on-time delivery and aims to maintain and exceed customer expectations. Team members join a growing manufacturer committed to innovation and customer satisfaction within the packaging industry. Role Description The Senior Graphic Designer is a full-time, on-site role based in 6th of October, responsible for leading design initiatives that support Alpha Pack’s packaging and branding objectives. Day-to-day tasks include creating and refining carton and packaging graphics, developing brand-aligned visual concepts, and designing logos and other identity assets for customers and internal use. The role involves preparing print-ready files, collaborating with production teams to ensure designs are technically compatible with corrugated materials, and maintaining visual consistency across all design outputs. The Senior Graphic Designer will also mentor junior designers, manage multiple projects, and contribute creative ideas that improve product appeal and support customer marketing goals. Qualifications Strong expertise in Graphic Design and Graphics for packaging applications, with a portfolio demonstrating relevant work. Proficiency in Logo Design and Branding to develop and refine visual identities for customers and Alpha Pack. Solid understanding of Typography and layout principles for effective, print-ready packaging designs. Advanced skills in industry-standard design software (e.g., Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign or equivalents). Experience working with print production, packaging materials, and pre-press processes, ideally in corrugated carton or related industries. Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, production, and customer service teams. Strong attention to detail, visual creativity, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate customer needs into effective design solutions. Relevant diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; senior-level experience in a similar role is highly preferred.

review_candidates.title: Senior Advanced Services Engineer (Support Integration) - Oracle Health
review_candidates.description: Job Description In this role, the Senior Advanced Services Engineer will: Take ownership of the Oracle Health Millennium production application environment, ensuring application stability, reliability, and operational excellence. Manage complex customer relationships, collaborating with key stakeholders and influencing decisions to achieve successful technical and business outcomes. Develop and oversee the execution of customer domain strategies, including incident management, change control, and continuous improvement initiatives. Lead the investigation, troubleshooting, and resolution of complex production incidents, working closely with engineering, support, and cross-functional teams. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate application, integration, and operational risks, serving as a senior technical escalation point. Provide technical leadership and domain expertise to internal teams and customer stakeholders, driving improvements in solution performance, integration, and stability. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Production Application Management: Develop and execute customer domain strategies to maintain the health, stability, security, and reliability of the Oracle Health Millennium production environment. Incident Management & Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve complex production incidents, perform root cause analysis, coordinate technical escalations, and drive timely resolution with relevant engineering and support teams. Proactive Monitoring & Stability: Analyze application performance, identify recurring issues and potential risks, and recommend preventive measures to improve system stability and operational efficiency. Change & Configuration Management: Oversee application changes, assess technical dependencies and potential impacts, and coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure compatibility and minimise production disruption. Technical Expertise: Investigate, maintain, troubleshoot, and configure Oracle Health Millennium components, including Discern Rules, Operations Jobs, Olympus, Print Services, Clinical Reporting, and basic Cerner Command Language (CCL). Integration Management: Provide technical oversight and expertise across integrated Oracle Health solutions, ensuring compatibility, reliability, and effective issue resolution. Customer Engagement: Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, lead technical discussions, communicate incident status and risks, and provide recommendations to improve application performance and reliability. Solution Configuration: Collaborate with customer and internal teams to evaluate workflow requirements, recommend appropriate application configurations, and support solution improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product development, infrastructure, and support teams to investigate complex issues, implement sustainable fixes, and drive long-term improvements. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and overall service delivery. Production Support: Participate in a 24/7 on-call support rotation as required, including critical incident response and on-site customer support when necessary. Required Qualifications & Experience Minimum 6 years of experience in healthcare information technology, including implementation, production application support, or managed services. Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Health Millennium, including production troubleshooting, application configuration, and integration support. Experience supporting multiple Oracle Health Millennium solutions, modules, and integrated applications within complex production environments. Practical knowledge of Discern Rules, Operations Jobs, Olympus, Print Services, Clinical Reporting, and basic CCL, including investigation, maintenance, modification, and configuration. Demonstrated experience managing complex production incidents, troubleshooting application and integration issues, and coordinating resolution across technical teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain customer confidence during high-impact production incidents. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in Information Technology, Healthcare Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Experience working within an Oracle Health Support or Application Managed Services organization. Experience performing root cause analysis, problem management, change management, and production stability improvement initiatives. Demonstrated ability to engage with senior customer stakeholders and influence technical decisions. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Experience supporting users via phone, email, chat, and remote support tools. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities. Familiarity with ticketing systems and ITIL-based service management practices is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Engineer, Technical Support
review_candidates.description: The Impact You'll Make As our Engineer, Technical Support, you’ll play a key role in delivering great customer experiences through expert, hands-on service. Your impact? You'll ensure minimal downtime and optimal performance for our customers' VSDs. Our service partners will be empowered with the knowledge to effectively support our products, and your feedback will directly contribute to the continuous improvement of our VSD offerings. You’ll collaborate with sales and product development teams and take ownership of advanced on-site technical support and service partner training. What You’ll Be Doing Lead hands-on, on-site diagnostics, troubleshooting, and complex repairs on VSDs to deliver minimal downtime and optimal performance. Support our service partners by developing and delivering comprehensive training programs to enhance their skills. Collaborate with the sales team on pre-sales support, including product demonstrations and application analysis. Use your skills in technical support to assist internal and external customers through phone, email, and a rotating on-call schedule. Continuously learn and share knowledge by providing valuable field feedback to the product development team to enhance our VSD offerings. What We're Looking For Hands-on experience in working with VSDs, including installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting, and a strong ability to deliver effective technical solutions. Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing complex electrical and electronic systems, with a required Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (A grade license). Ability to work well independently, with a willingness to travel to customer and partner sites as required. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. A mindset of problem-solving and a commitment to providing excellent customer and partner support. What You'll Get From Us We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are. You’ll receive a total rewards package that may include a range of benefits, depending on your location and contract type. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great. Ready to Make a Difference? If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us. Our Commitment to Transparency Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice. Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.
